question: Can analytic global swept-tube boundaries plus topology-isolated bounded local implicit unions qualify all 4773 C08 frames while preserving their route identities?
method: Analytically query sealed spline/radius tubes outside 25 explicit degree>=3 node windows. In each serial local window, union only incident tubes in a sphere of 1.10 times maximum incident radius at 0.10/0.05/0.025m; reject non-incident overlap and bad seams. Then solve XY/z only for route-local window frames and audit all 4773 frames with the hybrid field.
baseline: V1 complete-world dense SDF is rejected by its 178.67GiB 0.025m lower bound. The fallback is to stop; never merge non-incident tunnels, select a favourable resolution, lower thresholds or delete frames.

user_authorization.scope: V2 design is drafted; materialization and one-shot qualification require separate explicit approval.
user_authorization.confirmation_reference: User continued after the V1 dense-SDF cost failure, interpreted only as approval to draft the recommended local-window alternative.

acceptance_criteria: Exactly S01/S06/S10, 624 directed traversals and 4773 frame identities.
Exactly 25 degree>=3 windows (4/7/14) with source-derived membership/radii; no non-incident union or unsafe overlap.
All local seams are closed/manifold and each window has identical pass/fail identity at all three resolutions.
All 4773 frames meet horizontal>=0.8m, down [0.95,1.05]m, up>=0.8m and frozen continuity limits.
Zero LiDAR/model inference/graph/training/C09/C10/M-TARE and a complete evidence seal.
stop_conditions: Input/tool/count drift, window overlap, non-incident overlap, seam/manifold failure, cap breach, resolution disagreement, failed frame or continuity regression.
Any in-run window/radius/resolution/threshold change, frame deletion, route reorder or forbidden read.
expected_evidence: Input hashes, window manifests and serial peak-memory records.
Per-resolution local field/patch provenance, seam/manifold and isolation metrics, complete hybrid frame audit and corrected trajectories.
Raw log, visual review, environment/config snapshot, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU only; 4GiB peak RAM cap; zero GPU.
